policy.aliases: only <store>/aliases/*.json are mutable; re-pointing an anchor is an operational act with its own record.
policy.immutability: objects/ entries are content-addressed and mode 0444; originals are never moved or deleted; historical results are never overwritten.
policy.selection: Launchers, tests and eval scripts must name a LOGICAL ID and resolve it with tools/resolve_artifact.py. Selecting a weight by basename (checkpoint_last.pt / _best.pt / _boundary80.pt) is forbidden: three of those share a byte count in the same dir.
policy.verification: resolve_artifact re-hashes the object and fails closed on mismatch.
